write.greet.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# Greets the person given as the first argument.
echo "Hello, $1!"
echo "You gave $# arguments: $@"
echo "This script is $0"
write.check.sh:
#!/bin/bash
if [ -z "$1" ]; then
  echo "usage: check.sh FILE"
  exit 1
fi
if [ -f "$1" ]; then
  lines=$(wc -l < "$1")
  echo "$1 has $lines lines"
else
  echo "$1: no such file"
  exit 2
fi
write.backup.sh:
#!/bin/bash
for f in "$@"; do
  cp "$f" "$f.bak"
  echo "saved $f.bak"
done
write.countdown.sh:
#!/bin/bash
n=$1
while [ $n -gt 0 ]; do
  echo $n
  n=$((n - 1))
done
echo "Go!"
